actions.title: Record the main-film narration after the short pilot
actions.when: Raw recording Sep 19, noon; final cut Sep 20, 6 p.m.
actions.next: Use the current You handle today script in sections. Codex adds your voice/camera to the working assembly and trims the final film to 2:45–2:55, strictly below three minutes. Playback and publication remain separate checks.

actions.title: Finish Shopify order-to-stock proof
actions.next: Square Sandbox consumption and duplicate handling are verified locally. Shopify is connected and its catalog is readable; verify a paid development-store order next. Both implementations are merged and pushed, not proven released.

actions.title: Choose Wednesday evening’s product story

actions.title: Give founder responses a next step
actions.next: Use the follow-up list for relevant replies, introductions and hiring conversations. Keep a compact portfolio of your best public work ready to share.

actions.title: Check the napkin’s prerequisites

actions.title: Assemble the submission package

workstreams.detail: Ten product stories published. Six product stories are scheduled through Wednesday midday; four founder schedules remain separate. The napkin is held.

workstreams.detail: F01 now uses the founder video in its existing Sep 14 slot. F02–F04 remain the approved image posts until their recordings are edited.

workstreams.title: You handle today · launch film
workstreams.detail: The final cut combines owner footage, the real app components and staged story data. The edit and browser playback are verified. Your narration and camera remain.
workstreams.proof: Fresh ffprobe: 180.053333 seconds. The official judging criteria say under three minutes. This is a staged demonstration, not a real supplier order.

workstreams.title: Square + Shopify sales connections
workstreams.status: Square test verified; Shopify proof pending
workstreams.detail: Both integrations are merged into main. Square Sandbox consumed 60 boxes once and planned a 125-box buy. Shopify installation and catalog read succeeded.
workstreams.proof: Local provider receipts in artifacts/sales-connections; no Shopify order-to-stock proof or production integration release established.

workstreams.title: Walkthrough and app leads
workstreams.detail: Inquiry and booking have earlier release evidence. Demo tracking fix is merged and pushed; this review has not verified its production deployment.
workstreams.proof: September 14 production read: 26 tagged product visits, zero non-test inquiries, bookings or leads; launch checks excluded.

workstreams.title: First real supplier purchase
workstreams.detail: Hosted worker and controlled-store checks are documented. A completed real merchant purchase still needs a chosen supplier, item, terms and capped approval.
workstreams.proof: A staged film, sample dialogue or running worker is not evidence of a real supplier purchase.
